items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-07-29
items.q: I was up the coast. Up around General Arnold, Loke, Chula Irish General, man...

ctx.x: But you were on the downtown side of Canal Street, right?

I stood. I stood, but I was all over. I was over the river, I was trying to cut off a down low coast, I was up the coast. Up around General Arnold, Loke, Chula Irish General, man, on the back of Padres, and the cab rest in the tongue. Got it all off, am I, boy?
I don't know what I got in my head. I don't know what I got in my head. Mm-hmm. Pretty good, man. That's where the down.
